headers.//: Next writes metadata images as extensionless files (…/opengraph-image). A static host infers content type from the extension, so without this they are served as application/octet-stream and some link-preview scrapers refuse to render them. Verified against the live deployment.
The service worker must never be cached, or a stale copy can pin users to an old build.
Content-hashed build assets are safe to cache permanently.
